Definition: {to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)}
BiblicalUsage: Daniel was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him, when he saw the king's dream. The Aramaic word is to be stunned, struck still by what one has seen, and the king himself has to tell him not to let the dream trouble him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's silence is part of the prophecy, for he saw what was coming to Nebuchadnezzar and could not speak at once, and I hold that true prophets feel the weight of what they carry.
